decisions.reason: The source changes the qualification process, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the new three-clip trial and removing obsolete count and deadline attributes.
The candidate is introduced by this same source with the stated quota of 125 approved clips per month; the Lead Clipper role change requires no additional quota update.
The source establishes a new three-clip trial but does not specify or change the permitted source content.
The general rejection of prior quality and demand for three perfect clips does not specifically remove or change the caption-color standard.
The source does not specify a new duration range or revoke the existing 30–90-second standard.
The source's broad quality rejection does not necessarily alter the existing requirement to select strong source moments.
The source does not change or cancel the clean-editing standard; requiring perfect clips is compatible with that standard.
The source replaces the offer and trial structure but does not specify a new submission channel or necessarily revoke submission through project chat.
